builtInReadOnly: Built-in teams are read-only — duplicate first
description: A team is a private group conversation between you and multiple Agents. An explicit @ targets only those Agents. Without a mention, smart-primary routing selects one responder, all-response asks the roster, and moderator mode uses the designated leader.

editor.allowedToolsOverride: Allowed tools override (comma-separated; replaces character list)
editor.autoRoundsHelp: Extra rounds the room may run on its own when a member hands the floor to a teammate by name. 0 keeps one reply round per message.
editor.handoffTargetsHelp: Names this member is allowed to pass the conversation to. Anyone until you tick someone; no ticks means nobody.
editor.handoffTargetsNobody: Nobody: this member finishes its own contribution.
editor.mcpTeamHint: Applies to members that don't set their own MCP subset. Leave all unselected to mean "use every enabled server".
editor.name: Name
editor.overrideHelp: Each override replaces the corresponding character default for this team only. Leave blank to inherit. Skills always apply on top.
editor.replyConcurrencyHelp: One after another lets each member read the replies before it. All at once starts every member of a round together over the same transcript.
editor.responseCapHelp: Limits fan-out and moderator dispatches. Duplicate replies and repeated dispatches are suppressed.
editor.supervisorHelpAfter: to delegate to teammates, then synthesize the final reply.
editor.supervisorHelpBefore: The supervisor receives every user turn first and may either answer alone or emit
editor.supervisorPlaceholder: Pick a member to be the leader
editor.talkativenessHelp: How often this member chimes in on an auto round when nobody addressed it. 0 means only when handed the floor or mentioned. Needs auto rounds above 0.

emptyHint: No teams yet. The built-in "Brainstorm Squad" should appear automatically.
removeBody: "{name}" will be removed. Existing conversations stay but can no longer route to this team.
title: Teams

validation.atLeastOneMember: A team needs at least one member.
validation.autoRoundsInvalid: Auto rounds must be a whole number between 0 and 5.
validation.responseCapInvalid: The response cap must be an integer from 1 through 12.
validation.supervisorMustBeMember: The supervisor must be one of the team's members.
validation.supervisorRequired: Supervisor mode requires a designated supervisor.
validation.talkativenessInvalid: Speaks up must be a percentage from 0 through 100.
